business_problem: Adecco needed to respond to changing candidate expectations and handle high-volume, time-sensitive pre-screening faster, while preserving recruiter involvement and the human element in recruitment.
solution_summary: The Adecco Group deployed an AI-powered screening solution on Salesforce's Agentforce as the first wave of a broader global AI strategy. In the UK rollout, recruiters configure and shape the agent's inputs, then Agentforce runs early candidate screening conversations over SMS and email in a written format designed to mirror a live exchange. The system handles always-on outreach and pre-screening outside office hours, automating the first interaction layer so recruiters do not have to manually start every conversation. Agentforce then surfaces lists of engaged, pre-screened candidates ready for recruiter follow-up at the start of each day. The source does not name separate storage or analytics products, so the described architecture centers on the orchestration and serving layers: recruiter-defined prompts and criteria in Agentforce, candidate-facing AI conversations, and a human handoff back to Adecco recruiters for soft-skill assessment and next-step engagement.

solution_components.name: Agentforce
solution_components.role: It powers the AI agent that conducts written pre-screening conversations with candidates and returns engaged, pre-screened candidate lists to recruiters.

data_flow: Recruiters define the agent inputs in Agentforce, which then contacts candidates through SMS or email and runs automated written pre-screening exchanges. Completed conversations are processed into lists of engaged, pre-screened candidates that recruiters review at the start of each day for human follow-up.
business_outcome: The rollout helped Adecco engage candidates faster, extend interactions beyond office hours, free recruiters to focus on soft-skill assessment and meaningful follow-up, and deliver strong candidate satisfaction in production use.
metrics: 57% of these conversations took place outside standard working hours
